summary: Backend-only testing for the Italian AI Personal Coach API. Seeded a test user + session directly in MongoDB (user_id=user_test123, token=test-token-abc) and exercised the full flow end-to-end against the external EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with /api prefix. All 16 pytest cases passed in ~70s including real Claude Sonnet 5 calls via emergentintegrations. Covered: health, auth protection (missing + invalid bearer), goal creation with initial greeting, list/active goal, messages history, multi-turn interview reaching ready_to_generate=true with [PRONTO] stripped, plan generation producing status=active with milestones and daily_tasks having metric_label/metric_target/metric_unit + target_summary + feasibility_note, /today completed/total, task log persistence reflected in /today, /progress with 14-day series + streak + milestones, milestone toggle on/off, /checkin returning non-empty AI feedback and appearing in /checkins, and DELETE soft-delete removing the goal from listings and returning 404 on GET.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /goals/{goal_id} route is registered after /goals/active so path ordering is OK today, but any future dynamic route added before /goals/active could shadow it - consider prefixing static sub-routes or explicit ordering.
log_task upsert stores metric_value even when None; harmless but could be omitted when null for cleaner docs.
generate_plan catches generic Exception -> 502, which will also mask JSON parse failures; consider distinguishing LLM errors vs parse errors for observability.

auth_session inserts a new user_sessions doc every time without upserting on session_token (which is unique-indexed); repeated OAuth callbacks with same session_token would raise a duplicate-key error 500. Consider upsert.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py inserts users doc {user_id:user_test123, email:tester@example.com} and user_sessions doc {session_token:test-token-abc, expires_at:now+7d}; teardown cleans users/user_sessions/goals/messages/task_logs/checkins for that user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (seed_user autouse fixture) and BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Real Claude calls take 5-15s each; keep timeouts >=60s for LLM endpoints. Tests are ordered via a session-scoped `state` fixture (goal_id -> plan -> task_id/milestone_id -> checkin -> delete). If the LLM ever fails to emit [PRONTO], test_generate_plan still runs and validates plan shape.
